messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
If the GUTTER overhead travelling crane at position 10 were used under regular conditions, i.e. outside the construction, steel, port and extractive sectors, how often would it have to be verified?

response.text: Se il carroponte GUTTER in posizione 10 fosse utilizzato in condizioni ordinarie, cioè al di fuori dei settori edile, siderurgico, portuale ed estrattivo, con quale frequenza dovrebbe essere verificato?
